page.notes: Marginal note 1 is keyed to the superscript mark before "Conscientiam", and the asterisk note (Exod. 7. 1.) to "Mosen". The Greek line after "Menandri," is too faint to read reliably and is marked illegible. Greek words in the first paragraph (ἐπεργνητικὸν) and the mark after "magis" are doubtful. The word "fam" in note 1 is uncertain. The catchword "consti-" is read from the lower right of the column. The final line of text ends in a line-end without its full continuation on this page.
